confidence_explanation: The timeline clearly shows a user (user_02) accessing and downloading sensitive files from a department (finance) that is outside their authorized baseline (engineering). The pattern of reading the directory followed by downloading specific financial spreadsheets constitutes unauthorized data access/exfiltration.

attack_chain.description: User user_02 successfully logs in from their normal IP (192.168.1.102).
User user_02 performs unauthorized cross-department access by reading the /data/finance/confidential/ directory.
User user_02 downloads 'budget_2026.xlsx' from the finance department.
User user_02 downloads 'revenue_forecast.xlsx' from the finance department.

gaps: Lack of information regarding whether user_02 had a legitimate business reason or a support ticket to access finance data.
No information on whether user_02's credentials were compromised (e.g., phishing logs).
narrative: User_02, a senior developer in engineering, accessed and downloaded sensitive financial documents (budget and revenue forecasts) from the finance department. This activity deviates significantly from their established baseline and constitutes unauthorized cross-departmental data exfiltration.
